source: master session 2026-08-18 - security_review template first run

lessons.title: A strict output schema needs a model strong enough to hold it; the free lane will fail clean, not degrade
lessons.problem: The security_review template requires findings with an acknowledged packet hash plus several required arrays (claims, gaps, contradictions, proposed_revisions) and a bounded confidence. The free-lane model (@cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash) could not reliably produce that shape: it dropped the packet-hash echo and required fields.
method: Mark judgment-heavy templates with prefersProfile 'paid-k2' so operators know the free lane is not enough.
Trust the coordinator's schema rejection: it retried three times and failed the job rather than emitting malformed findings. That is correct behavior, not a bug.
When a job fails on schema validation repeatedly with the same model, the fix is a stronger model lane, not loosening the schema.
signals_it_applies: job_failed with 'schema validation failed: packet acknowledgement hash does not match; ... is required'
the same small model fails the same way on retry
the template demands structured findings, citations, or exact field echoes
hard_nos: Do not loosen the result schema just to make a weak model pass - that would let malformed or unsourced findings through
Do not report a security finding the verifier could not confirm as if it were confirmed
Do not treat a clean multi-retry failure as the system being broken
lessons.evidence: cloudflare-ops-mcp 2026-08-18: security_review job e77f646a on a deliberately vulnerable password-change endpoint; free GLM-4.7-flash failed the findings schema 3x and the job failed clean with 0 fabricated claims. Template now marked prefersProfile paid-k2.
